question: The 'Sign Out' component of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist is completed before the first incision to confirm patient identity and site marking.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is false. Sign Out occurs before the patient leaves the theatre at the end of the operation. Patient identity and site confirmation are performed at 'Sign In' and 'Time Out', respectively.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this is false. Sign Out occurs at the end of the procedure, before the patient leaves the operating room, to confirm counts and post-operative plans. The pre-incision check is called 'Time Out'.
